name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Tameeni is the digital insurance brand of Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange; the CMA prospectus describes Tameeni Company as a wholly-owned group subsidiary. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: ownership chain stops at Rasan Information Technology (listed on the Saudi Exchange, Tadawul 8313); no state stake or board seat identified in the sources opened, and no human-rights finding against the company → none. Checked further on review (2026-10-03): the prospectus (Section 4.1.3) names Rasan's 5%+ holders as four individuals plus two Osool & Bakheet custodian vehicles for the Impact46-managed Venture Capital InsurTech Fund and Impact Growth Fund, and Impact46 announced on its own site (impact46.sa news, 13 March 2025) a 'successful exit from Rasan Information Technology Company through an accelerated bookbuild offering', so the Impact46-managed funds no longer hold Rasan shares.
